Package org.cyborgcats.component

Class Setpoint

java.lang.Object
org.cyborgcats.component.Setpoint
public class Setpoint extends Object
Represents a motor control setpoint (neutral, voltage, duty cycle, velocity, or position) and provides factory methods for each mode. Applying a setpoint delegates to the appropriate MotorIO method.
